dataset.description: mixed cross-fruit testbed: 3 frames per dataset, each dataset's own TEST split, GT per its protocol
dataset.selection_rule: per source: test split, keep frames with >= 3 GT instances (wgisd: also require cluster-mask .npz), sort by file name, pick 3 evenly spaced indices

strawdi.task: strawberry instance segmentation (visible-surface masks); detection as mask-derived boxes
strawdi.reference_metrics: mask F1@IoU-0.5 (+ mask AP@50, mAP; box F1@0.5)

minneapple.task: apple detection (COCO boxes) + instance segmentation (COCO polygons)
minneapple.reference_metrics: COCO-style AP@[.50:.95] + AP@50 (detection and segmentation); F1@0.5 reported for the single-model VLM setting

wgisd.task: grape-cluster detection (boxes); instance segmentation on the masked subset (cluster masks)
wgisd.reference_metrics: mAP@0.5 (bunch detection); F1@0.5 for the VLM setting

acfr_apples.task: apple detection (circle annotations read as boxes)
acfr_apples.reference_metrics: object-wise F1 (IoU 0.5) per Bargoti & Underwood 2017 convention

kfuji.task: Fuji apple detection (RGB patches of Kinect v2 frames; RGB-D variants exist but this study is RGB-only)
kfuji.reference_metrics: P/R/F1 (frame-level, Gené-Mola et al. 2019 convention) + AP; F1@0.5 here

coordinate_convention.bbox: [x1, y1, x2, y2] whole pixels, top-left origin, delivered-frame space

gt_conventions.acfr_mangoes: rectangles (x, y = TOP-LEFT, dx, dy = size)
gt_conventions.acfr_almonds: rectangles (x, y = TOP-LEFT, dx, dy = size)
gt_conventions.wgisd: YOLO-normalised txt boxes; npz mask i == txt line i
gt_conventions.minneapple: COCO bbox + polygon rings (instance may have >1 ring)

gt_masks.note: ACFR apples ship a SEMANTIC (non-instance) pixel mask; mangoes/almonds none. Instance GT is boxes only — polygons are asked but unscored, as in the base vlm_seg pipeline.
